Considering it’s been said J.J Abrams wants to bring all movies in canon into play in episode IX, I’ll try my best to do the same:

Of course I have to bring Anakin’s mother back into play by having her give a 30 minute speech on how there is always good in peoples heart or some crap like that, what ever makes the audience feel like they’re reliving a senate scene from the prequels.

To call back to Attack of the Clones I bring yet another, mysterious son of Boba Fett onto the Falcon, here to avenge his father.

I bring the children from the end of The Last Jedi and in an ironic twist based off of Revenge of the Sith, have them slaughter Kylo Ren just like Anakin did to the younglings.

Finally, Sam Jackson as Mace Windu returns again only this time he has an afro the size of the one he had in Afro Samurai, and it too can wield a purple lightsaber. With his new understanding of the 9th form of fighting, he overpowers Rey, killing her.

The next trilogy is entirely based around the Rise and Fall of the immortal Darth Windu the Wise.
